title: United-Guardian Reports 2025 Financial Results
summary: Pharmaceutical sales rose 15% and medical lubricants gained 4%. United-Guardian says two PBM approvals for Renacidin can widen patient access.
body_markdown:

Trading volume was exceptionally heavy at **6.2x** the daily average, suggesting very strong buying interest.
